```lean
theorem lg_target {n a : ℕ} : (∃ x, x ^ n = a) ↔ n = 0 ∧ a = 1 ∨ n ≠ 0 ∧ n.nthRoot a ^ n = a := by
  split
  · intro h
    cases h with h1 h2
    · exact ⟨1, by rw [h1, pow_zero]⟩
    · rcases h2 with h3 | h4
      · exact ⟨n, h3⟩
      · exact ⟨n, h4⟩
  · intro h
    cases h with h1 h2
    · have h3 : (n.nthRoot a) ^ n = a := h2
      exact ⟨n, h3⟩
    · have h3 : (n.nthRoot a) ^ n = a := h2
      exact ⟨n, h3⟩
```
